notes.subject: laip bilong mi
notes.rationale: נפש is breath/life-force, not 'soul'; Tok Pisin 'laip bilong mi' keeps the life-force shape.

notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Hebrew בו supplies the object pronoun; bracketed where Tok Pisin needs it standalone.

notes.subject: to Israel
notes.rationale: Servant Song opens with summons 'Lukim' — the reader is called to behold the servant.

translation: Lukim, sevat bilong mi — mi holim strong ⟨em⟩; man bilong mi ol i makim, laip bilong mi i ampas long em. Mi putim ruak bilong mi long em; em bai bringim kot aut long ol lain bilong ol narapela kantri.

tokens.gloss: man bilong mi ol i makim
long ol lain bilong ol narapela kantri
